canonical_project: Ark Data Centres Longcross Park / LP02 expansion

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Ark operates the Longcross Park campus in Surrey. Public reports say Ark is investing GBP807m, with planning approval for vertical extensions, supporting infrastructure upgrades, and a new 36MW LP02 facility; Nebius is expanding its AI cloud deployment at the campus after an initial 16MW lease.
